info.name: StyleMind COD Delivery Collection
info.description: One admin delivery command persists COD collection intent. Existing PaymentConfirmed outbox/inbox delivers payment progress.

item.name: Admin delivers and collects COD in one command (safe replay)

exec: pm.test('Delivery is committed and payment progress is explicit', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const p = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(p.order_status).to.eql('COMPLETED'); pm.expect(p.payment_method).to.eql('COD'); pm.expect(['PENDING','PAID']).to.include(p.payment_status); });

item.name: Owner checks delivery and payment synchronization

exec: pm.test('Owner sees delivered state and honest payment status', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const p = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(p.order_status).to.eql('COMPLETED'); pm.expect(['PENDING','PAID']).to.include(p.payment_status); });

item.name: Owner checks return eligibility after payment event delivery
Internal collection denies missing service credential
Internal recovery replays committed delivery intent

exec: pm.test('Existing COD attempt is paid', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const p = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(p.status).to.eql('PAID'); pm.expect(p.method).to.eql('COD'); });
